answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a costly, verifiable bond that is slashed on fraud, so spawning a thousand sock-puppet agents costs a thousand times the stake. A violet badge could mark verified stakers, while a walnut-sized hardware attestation ties each account to one physical device. Honest agents keep a marble-smooth reputation; attackers face real economic loss per fake identity, making mass sybil creation unprofitable.
